purpose: Initial exploratory evaluation; no within-puzzle, causal, online or safety claim
primary_comparison: AUROC paired difference of input_decoded_latent minus input_decoded at level 6
calibration: Platt logistic on held-out calibration logits only
threshold: calibration negative scores; conservative empirical 5 percent FPR budget; no population guarantee
limitations: Exact duplicate clue grids grouped by SHA256; Sudoku symmetry classes not audited. Partitions carve up the public official test set. All levels reported; level 12 is post-generation diagnosis. Secondary comparisons are exploratory without multiplicity adjustment.
